pages.text: $(li)$(l)Quest sharing:$() form a party in the questbook's party menu (press $(o)Back$() at the bottom left of the questbook). Complete any checkbox quests yourselves.

As a last resort, the most advanced player runs $(5)/bq_copyquests <name>$() to copy their progress to a teammate. This overwrites that teammate's progress.$(li)$(l)EMC and knowledge sharing:$() join the same $(l)FTB Team$() (top left of your inventory;

this is separate from the quest party) and enable sharing. A new team starts with 0 EMC; turning sharing off returns you to your personal EMC. Pull out high-value items such as Red Matter blocks before switching.$(li)$(l)ExU2 GP sharing:$() $(5)/xu_powersharing$().
$(li)Difficulty gamestages apply $(l)around each player$(), so one player's progress doesn't make mobs harder for everyone.
